name: Cable Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
steps: Stand facing a high pulley and reach up for the handle with one hand.
Draw your elbow down toward the same hip to bring your hand beside your shoulder.
Extend your arm overhead again under control.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your ribs down without leaning away from the working side.
Keep your forearm in line with the cable as you draw your elbow toward your hip.
